site_name: Flats 3 and 4, 21-22 Queen's Gate Gardens, LONDON, SW7 5LZ
description: Internal alterations to facilitate the reconfiguration of Flats 3 & 4 comprising: expansion of Flat 3 (flat at third floor level) to include the area of Flat 4 at second floor level; formation of access between floor levels achieved through new staircase positioned against historic party wall in the outrigger extension; retention of Flat 4 on lower second floor within the outrigger extension, to be subdivided from existing flat through the removal of the staircase; changes to plan form of rear landing area of existing Flat 4 to create a room and WC; and changes to Flat 3 to form new en suite within rear room (Listed Building Consent only)
